source.title: Ifa Divination: Communication Between Gods and Men in West Africa
source.author: William R. Bascom
source.notes: Verified 2026-07-28 via Internet Archive controlled lending (ifadivinationcom0000basc). Table 1 p. 4 and Table 3 col. B p. 48 verified all 16 principal figures. Verses occupy pp. 140-563; bibliography pp. 565-575. Bascom numbers his 256 figures by the Ifẹ order (Table 1), not the southwestern order used as this dataset's default, so his figure numbers do not match seniority_rank.

transcription.method: read by eye from the Internet Archive scan
transcription.note: Notation preserved verbatim in each pageReference so the derivation of contracted names can be checked, not trusted.
